research_question: Does learned Householder mirror activation of a NoPE semantic head improve a RoPE/NoPE hybrid recurrent attention block over comparable FiLM and coupled rank-one controls, while retaining positional competence?

model.position_semantics: head0 RoPE/head1 RoPE for rope; both NoPE for nope; head0 RoPE/head1 NoPE for hybrid
model.insertion: Only the head1 VALUE vector receives an activation gate per recurrent step. Shared uses silu(v); Mirror uses H silu(H v), same shared weights, two learned H codes. FiLM uses silu(v*(1+0.8*tanh(gamma))), two gamma vectors. Coupled_rank1 uses S silu(S v) with S=I+beta*uu^T, beta learnable initialized -2, strictly contains Mirror when beta=-2, two code vectors and two beta scalars. Fixed_mirror uses two fixed seeded H vectors stored and included in packet.
model.head_ff: Both heads use shared causal self-attention weights across passes, pre-norm, a residual projection, and shared SiLU FFN; only head1's gated value differs by arm.
model.initialization: Identical learned embedding, backbone, readout initialization across all arms and positions within seed; mirror/fixed/coupled_rank1 use equal initial code directions and matched beta=-2; FiLM gamma initialized zero. Record initial activation and function change on actual train input; no tuning after results.

tasks.set_membership: 10 key/value content tokens; query key at last token; balanced yes iff a token with query key occurs; ignores ordering
tasks.last_value: 10 key/value content tokens; query fixed special token; balanced label equals bit at last content position; requires positional selection but not query-key matching
tasks.last_matching_key: 10 key/value content tokens; query key at last token; at least 2 occurrences of query key with opposing bits; balanced label is bit of latest occurrence. Requires key match and relative recency.

design.note: No hyperparameter selection across arms after looking at fresh; checkpoint by each arm DEV CE only. Fresh and OOD strictly generated after checkpoint hashes sealed. OOD uses 14 content tokens and differing split seed.

decision.primary: At least 2/3 paired seeds: Fresh CE hybrid/mirror <= min(hybrid/film CE, hybrid/coupled_rank1 CE)-0.02 on last_matching_key. Also no negative positional control >0.02 CE versus hybrid/film on last_value.
decision.interaction_diagnostic: Within last_matching_key compute delta=(CE_hybrid_film-CE_hybrid_mirror) - (CE_rope_film-CE_rope_mirror) per matched seed. Report paired values and sign, not a separate causal proof.
decision.resource_gate: Even if quality passes, usefulness additionally requires a Pareto comparison of torch.save bytes, batch64 forward time and training time against non-Mirror controls; no claimed speedups from parameter counts alone.
decision.stopping: No extension or retraining based on Fresh; preserve failure and do not create new seeds to chase gains.

limitations: Tiny synthetic Transformer, 3 seeds, 450 updates. One RoPE and one NoPE head, not a full LM. Orthogonal Householder may not help and coupled rank1 contains it; no assumption of Mirror-specific superiority. The 14-token OOD extrapolation may violate learned length inductive biases; no claim about long-context LMs. Manual CPU implementation, fixed update budget is not FLOP equality.
